ordered_branches.explanation: Warehouse comes from filter parser. Pending loads: trailing status700 through800 inclusive. Future loads: scheduled date > warehouse-local current DATE and trailing>201,<900; a later time today can qualify because boundary is midnight. These load displays COUNT internal load rows while threshold helpers receive COUNT DISTINCT load IDs. Shipments-to-route counts distinct shipment IDs with NULL carrier and trailing<900. Culture and declared numeric caution/warning variables are unused; critical levels use supplied expressions.

program.text: SELECT @warehouse = filterValue from @criteriaTempTable WHERE filterName = N'<literal:1>'
from SHIPPING_LOAD_VIEW where TRAILING_STS >= 700 and TRAILING_STS <=800 and warehouse=@warehouse
from SHIPPING_LOAD_VIEW where SCHEDULED_SHIP_DATE> (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate)) and warehouse=@warehouse and TRAILING_STS > 201 and TRAILING_STS <900
from Metadata_Insight_Shipment_View where SHIPMENT_HEADER_CARRIER is null and warehouse=@warehouse and SHIPMENT_HEADER_TRAILING_STS <900
